title: Skip unpartitioned staging for heap-layout agg HTs
hypothesis: The join feeds the aggregate ~300-row chunks, so FindOrCreateGroupsInternal (aggregate_hashtable.cpp ~line 758) sends new groups to unpartitioned_data staging. Abandon/ClearPointerTable later repartitions them, which copies the VARCHAR heap and recomputes pointers. Measured earlier: Abandon 37->2ms and MaybeRepartition 97->56ms CPU when staging only for AllConstant layouts. Wall time was about -5% (noisy).
plan: In GroupedAggregateHashTable::FindOrCreateGroupsInternal, use the unpartitioned staging path only when layout.AllConstant(); otherwise append directly to partitioned_data.
generality: Aggregates with VARCHAR/nested keys fed by small chunks. Fixed-width layouts are unchanged.
risk: Low. Two-line gate. Spill paths need a test with long-string keys.
